messages:
Emily Chen: :rotating_light: incident-bot alerted - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (us-east) starting ~10:42 UTC. Seeing error spike to ~18% for a subset of requests. Creating warroom and paging on-call.
incident-bot: Pager triggered to @oncall, warroom: https://meet.redwood/warroom/5180004321, incident id: INC-2026-5180.
Carlos Ruiz: joining warroom, pulling recent deploys and autoscale graphs.
Maya Patel: oncall here, pager acked. I can take owner if needed.
Tom Nguyen: owner please - can you confirm scope (production vs staging) and affected endpoints?
Maya Patel: taking owner. quick summary: production embeddings and generation routes for eu/us-east, errors are 502/503. Not all tenants but high-volume customers impacted intermittently.
Emily Chen: customer-impact assessment: partial outage for embedding-heavy flows; latency also spikes. Recommend status page "degraded performance" and targeted customer notifications to enterprise sandbox and batch-ingest users.
Sarah Blake: drafted status update (will post after confirm):
---
We are investigating elevated errors for API endpoints related to embeddings and generation in US-EAST. Some customers may experience 5xx responses or increased latency. Our engineers are actively investigating and have created a war room.
Impacted services: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate (US-EAST)
User impact: intermittent 5xx responses and higher latency for some requests
Next update: 30 minutes
---
Tom Nguyen: +1 to post that. Also we need a short customer email template for affected enterprise accounts. Sarah can you post a quick template we can send to the account owners?
Sarah Blake: draft email (short):
---
Subject: Incident affecting embeddings/generation (US-EAST)
Hello [Customer],
We are investigating elevated errors and latency for embedding and generation requests routed to US-EAST. You may see 5xx responses intermittently. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation now. We will provide updates within 30 minutes. If you require assistance or a temporary reroute, please reply and we will prioritize.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Incident Response Team
---
Maya Patel: mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback model variant with lower memory (roll to v1-era quantized) 2) scale dedicated pool + add temporary burst nodes 3) enable prefix KV-cache bypass for problematic corpora 4) rollback recent routing change if spike persists. I'll start step 1 and 2 now.
Carlos Ruiz: logs show an increased GC/oom churn on a small subset of pods with mixed-precision kernels. I pushed a quick config to increase pool size and disabled aggressive prefetch for those instances.
incident-bot: Warroom link pinned and ops bridge created: https://meet.redwood/warroom/5180004321 (started by Emily Chen).
Emily Chen: confirm on-call handoff at 11:15 UTC if still ongoing. Maya, report back when mitigation starts showing metrics improvement.
Maya Patel: mitigation started at 10:49 UTC - scaling up pools and enabling fallback. Initial error rate down to ~12% from 18% in the last 5m. Will update in 10m.
Tom Nguyen: I'll coordinate comms with sales for affected enterprise customers. Sarah please queue email and mark affected tenants.
Sarah Blake: queued email to priority list, ready to send after owner's ack.
Emily Chen: Good start. Keep warroom focused on these actions: owner (Maya), logs/tracing (Carlos), comms (Tom/Sarah), escalation if no improvement in 20m. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: ack, will update with metrics in 10.
Carlos Ruiz: adding runbook snippet to warroom: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=us-east -o wide` then patch scaling.
Emily Chen: closing initial kickoff thread, continuing in warroom.
